name: arxa-git-workspace
description: Phase 3 of docs/plans/file-organisation-implementation.md — the git rail: org repo init at scaffold with nested project repos ignored by the org repo (D37), per-project repos, two-tier commits (continuous local-only WIP auto-commits squashed into clean stage-boundary commits, D18), and the version-chip data source (D20 semantic version + state, no SHAs in UX per D44). Engine: shell out to system git with a startup probe and a clear disabled state when git is absent. No sessions/worktrees (phase 4), no network, no DB.
